what_follows.question: Oksana takes a desk job for two years and never weighs flour. Going only by the passage, which of these has most likely faded when she comes back?
what_follows.right: stopping the scoop without a glance
wrong: tying her apron at the bench
hearing the radio on the shelf

what_follows.question: A new baker takes Oksana's place on a first day. Going only by the passage, which of these would most likely be missing?
what_follows.right: the scoop stopping without a glance
wrong: a radio playing on the shelf
an apron tied before the work
a call for the baking trays
a bench standing by the wall
a scale sitting on the bench
